description: Propagate2..8 hard intervals through sum/difference/product/quotient, or combine1..8 uncorrelated standard-uncertainty terms using entered derivatives. Interval arithmetic expands endpoints outward; statistical coverage factors do not establish confidence levels. Returns a calculation receipt with inputs, results, assumptions, validation checks and source. The receipt is unsigned, not independent certification. No private data, external lookup or arbitrary code execution. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

operation.description: Difference/quotient use exactly two ordered operands. Other operations use2..8.

ranges.description: Hard input bounds, not standard deviations. Caller must align/derive units. Divisor interval must exclude zero.

coverageFactor.description: Multiplier for combined standard uncertainty; does not imply a confidence level.

nominal.description: Nominal output estimate, in output units

terms.description: Assumes uncorrelated input uncertainties; uses first-order linear propagation.

sensitivity.description: Entered local derivative dy/dx, output units per input unit

standardUncertainty.description: Standard uncertainty of this input, not an interval width.

name: buscalc_uncertainty
title: Bounded ranges and uncertainty propagation
